DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

 

SPECIMEN

:

FINE NEEDLE ASPIRATE

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

TEST

:

CULTURE

      

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

RESULT

:

No  growth of any micro-organism  during 48 hours of

incubation at 37 degree centigrade.                   

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

          NOTE : There may be an alteration in the growth characteristic of an organism if the patient is under a treatment with

                        any antibiotic and if not withdrawn at least 7 day prior to the test. Hence the interpretation may be done accordingly. 

 

         NB: Suggested Clinical Correlation & repeat examination if necessary.

MEDICAL MICROBIOLOGY

 

 

SPECIMEN

:

FINE NEEDLE ASPIRATE

      

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

TEST

:

CULTURE (Aerobic)

      

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

RESULT

:

No growth of any pathogenic micro-organisms after 48 Hrs incubation at 37 ºC under aerobic conditions.                   

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

          NOTE : There may be an alteration in the growth characteristic of an organism if the patient is under a treatment  

                     with any antibiotic and if not withdrawn at least 7 day prior to the test. Hence the interpretation may be 

                     done accordingly. 

 

         NB: Suggested Clinical Correlation & repeat examination if necessary.

FINE NEEDLE ASPIRATE

      

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

TEST

:

CULTURE (Aerobic)

      

 

 

 

 

 

RESULT

:

Aerobic Culture at 37ºc shows growth of Escherichia coli /Klebsiella sp. / Pseudomonas sp./ Staphylococcus Sp./Proteus sp. /Streptococcus Sp/Staphylococcus aureus

 Insignificant Bacteriuria

Hence, Sensitivity not put up.

 

 

 

 

 

          NB: Suggested Clinical Correlation & repeat examination if necessary.
